title: Advanced 3D Kaleidoscope with Scoring System
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D kaleidoscope scene using Three.js with a scoring system. The entire application should be in a single HTML file.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0, 12), FOV 60, looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a point light at (5, 5, 5) with intensity 1.0.
- Background color: black (#000000).

## Kaleidoscope Geometry
- Create a kaleidoscope with `segmentCount` = 6 mirror segments arranged radially around the Z-axis.
- Each segment contains 3 floating geometric shapes: a TorusKnot (scale 0.3), an Icosahedron (scale 0.25), and an Octahedron (scale 0.2).
- Each shape uses MeshStandardMaterial with metalness 0.7 and roughness 0.3.
- The shapes in the first segment are the 'source' shapes; the other 5 segments mirror them by rotating copies by (index * 2*PI/6) around the Z-axis.
- All source shapes orbit slowly in the first segment (radius 1.5, different speeds: torusKnot at 0.3 rad/s, icosahedron at 0.5 rad/s, octahedron at 0.7 rad/s).
- Mirror copies must update their positions each frame to mirror the source shapes.

## Color Modes
- Support 3 color modes: 'rainbow' (default), 'monochrome', 'complementary'.
- 'rainbow': each segment gets a hue offset = segmentIndex * (360/6) degrees, applied via HSL.
- 'monochrome': all shapes use hue 0.6 (blue) with varying lightness per segment (0.3 to 0.8).
- 'complementary': alternating segments use hue 0.0 (red) and hue 0.5 (cyan).
- Press 'C' to cycle through color modes in order: rainbow -> monochrome -> complementary -> rainbow.

## Rotation & Speed Control
- The entire kaleidoscope group auto-rotates around Z-axis at `rotationSpeed` = 0.5 rad/s initially.
- Press 'ArrowUp' to increase rotationSpeed by 0.25 (max 3.0).
- Press 'ArrowDown' to decrease rotationSpeed by 0.25 (min 0.0).
- Press 'Space' to toggle pause/resume of all animation (rotation + orbiting). When paused, nothing moves.

## Symmetry Control
- Press 'S' to cycle segment count: 6 -> 8 -> 10 -> 12 -> 6.
- When segment count changes, rebuild all mirror segments accordingly. Source shapes remain, mirrors are recalculated.

## Scoring System
- Display a HUD overlay with: Score, Combo, Color Mode, Segment Count, Speed.
- Score starts at 0. A 'combo' multiplier starts at 1.
- Every time the user changes color mode (press C), add (10 * combo) to score and increment combo by 1.
- Every time the user changes segment count (press S), add (25 * combo) to score and increment combo by 1.
- Every time the user changes speed (ArrowUp/ArrowDown), add (5 * combo) to score.
- If the user presses 'R' (reset), score resets to 0, combo resets to 1, rotationSpeed resets to 0.5, segmentCount resets to 6, colorMode resets to 'rainbow', and animation unpauses.
- The combo resets to 1 if 5 seconds pass without any scoring action. Track this with a lastActionTime timestamp.

## Particle Burst Effect
- When score crosses a multiple of 100 (100, 200, 300...), trigger a particle burst: spawn 50 small sphere particles at the origin that fly outward with random velocities and fade out over 1.5 seconds. Track the last threshold crossed to avoid re-triggering.

## HUD Elements
- Position a div with id='hud' at top-left, styled with white text, font-family monospace, padding 15px, semi-transparent dark background.
- Show: Score (id='hud-score'), Combo (id='hud-combo'), Color Mode (id='hud-color-mode'), Segments (id='hud-segments'), Speed (id='hud-speed'), Paused status (id='hud-paused').
- Add a 'Reset' button with id='reset-btn' in the HUD that triggers the same reset as pressing 'R'.

## State Management
- Expose `window.__3D_STATE__` with these fields updated every frame:
  - `score` (number)
  - `combo` (number)
  - `colorMode` (string: 'rainbow'|'monochrome'|'complementary')
  - `segmentCount` (number)
  - `rotationSpeed` (number)
  - `isPaused` (boolean)
  - `shapeCount` (number, total shapes in scene including mirrors)
  - `particleBurstCount` (number, how many bursts have been triggered total)
  - `kaleidoscopeRotationZ` (number, current Z rotation of the main group in radians)
  - `sourceShapePositions` (array of 3 objects with {x, y, z} for the 3 source shapes)
  - `lastScoreThreshold` (number, last multiple of 100 crossed, starts at 0)
  - `frameCount` (number, incremented each animation frame, starts at 0)
  - `comboTimerActive` (boolean, true if combo > 1 and timer hasn't expired)
physics_constraints: Shapes must orbit at specified angular velocities. Mirror segments must maintain exact rotational symmetry. Particle bursts must follow outward radial motion with fade-out. Rotation speed must be clamped between 0.0 and 3.0. Combo timer must reset combo to 1 after 5 seconds of inactivity.
